maya singh: Heads-up — trying a different speculative approach today: 'beamlet' micro-beam + prefix prefetch. quick notes.
liam chen: beamlet? brief idea?
maya singh: split speculative picker into small beams (k=3 micro-beams) that prefetch top-2 token KV for each beam and interleave decode. hope: reduce wasted compute vs full-beam while keeping quality.
liam chen: sounds interesting. what's the plan to measure quality vs standard top-p/nucleus? need eval sets.
maya singh: plan: run on onboard-suite A (200 prompt holdout) + summarization subset (100) + code-gen (50). metrics: exact-match/ROUGE/BLEU + human quality quick sample (5 per split).
juniper: what quantization config?
maya singh: 4-bit GPTQ per-layer with group size 128, and a FP16 baseline. also test q4_0 vs q4_k on same model (ozma-14b-mini, but also a 70b slice for perf).
samir: can you dump the run command? I'll spin infra
maya singh: yes: ```./run_eval --model ozma-14b-mini --decode beamlet --micro_beams 3 --prefetch 2 --quant q4_k --prompts holdout_A.json --out /tmp/beamlet_q4k.json``` 
ops-bot: deploy triggered: p-queue/experiment-45 started by maya singh :rocket:
liam chen: latency targets? we need P99 under 250ms for microbeams or else it's pointless
maya singh: target P99 token-latency <250ms on A100-80GB. if >300ms we fall back to greedy.
audrey: any early quality concerns? speculative sometimes drops longer-range coherence
maya singh: initial small run (10 prompts) shows 2/10 had trailing incompletions vs FP16 greedy; but top-1 correctness on code tests improved in 3 cases. Not significant yet.
liam chen: sounds like we need more runs and a side-by-side scoring script. I'll add `scripts/compare_beamlet.py` to compute ngram overlap + perplexity delta.
juniper: also record token-level wasted compute: tokens spec'd but then abandoned. that was big in previous experiments.
maya singh: noted — adding KV_cache_miss and prefetch_waste counters. sync up 3pm for results? :calendar:
samir: 3pm works for me.
maya singh: cool — I'll post first 100-run aggregate to this thread when done. tagging @audrey for human review.
